Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: orthographic albedo texture-source painting for an existing 3D model.
Edit IMAGE 1, the guide, painting surfaces ONLY. IMAGE 2, design_reference.png, is the approved MATERIAL AND COLOUR reference only; never copy its perspective, silhouette, studio lighting or framing.
Return a single 1024 x 1024 PNG with true transparent background. Keep the guide's exact pixel canvas, projection, orientation, position, scale, outer alpha silhouette, every part boundary and empty space. Do not enlarge the object to fill the frame. Nothing added outside the guide silhouette; nothing cropped; no camera tilt, perspective or redesigned geometry.
Subject: thin colonial data slate with lightly worn warm-white ceramic, brushed warm gold rim and gold stylus, and dark charcoal glass screen. Copy the approved reference's materials and restrained corner wear onto the guide's existing parts. The guide's grey, cream and blue-grey colours are only part labels, not finished colours. Paint subtle fine ceramic scratches and small gold scuffs, faint brushed metal grain, fine panel joins and seams, with all detail confined within existing silhouettes.
